notes.text: Available in cPanel 11.48 and later; returns the IP address of the user who most recently logged in using the selected account context. No request arguments or defaults are declared in the pinned operation.

The pinned payload is a list of strings, rather than a scalar address. Preserve list order, duplicates and an empty list; do not infer nullable values or perform IP normalization. A missing data member is a payload mismatch.
